paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters remains open across 13 states, with 28 cases and 5 hospitalizations reported as of October 30 [1]. A Class I recall of Imperio Fuego Beef Jerky has been issued because the product was produced without inspection; affected 2 oz. sealed bags were sold in Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, and Wisconsin [2].

Vitality Works Inc. is recalling 365 Whole Foods Market Standardized + Full Spectrum Blend Ashwagandha Capsules (lot number 2025-26227) due to potential Salmonella contamination [4]. SLR Food Distribution Inc. recalls Wise Wife Brand Ground Cinnamon because it may contain elevated lead levels [5]. Taylor Farms is recalling H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kits due to potential undeclared soy and almonds, which can cause serious reactions or death in people with allergies [6]. HAIFA SMOKED FISH is recalling Cold Smoked Sprats due to potential Clostridium botulinum contamination; consumers should not use the product even if it appears normal [7].
The FDA has warned against Once Upon a Farm Tractor Wheels Organic Toddler Soft-Baked Bars in all flavors and lot numbers due to reports of infants choking [8].
